## Summary

One sentence for the release notes; for a dependency update, what was bumped.

## Why

What made this worth doing, in a sentence or two.

## Change

What moved, was removed or was bumped, as a sentence or a short list. For a dependency update, anything notable or breaking in the bumped versions.

## Verification

How "behavior unchanged" was proven, then the commands in a fenced block.

## Review

- Code review: what it found and what became of it, or "nothing outstanding".
- Set aside: findings left alone, and why.
- CodeRabbit: its findings and their outcome, or "not requested".

## Docs

The docs updated, or "none".
